dongle.desc_CN: 1.修复部分电脑长时间未使用后首次开机，音箱音量调节范围异常的问题。
dongle.desc_EN: 1. Fixed the issue where the speaker volume adjustment range was abnormal on some PCs when powered on for the first time after being idle for a long time.

desc_CN: 1.优化充电电量显示准确性，改善电量虚高问题
2.优化蓝牙音频（A2DP）音量曲线，提升音量调节体验
3.修复频繁调整 EQ 设置时，耳机偶发死机的问题，提升设备稳定性
desc_EN: 1.Optimize the accuracy of charging level display to fix the false high battery level issue.
2.Optimize the Bluetooth audio (A2DP) volume curve for a better volume adjustment experience.
3.Fix the occasional headset crash when EQ settings are adjusted frequently to improve device stability.

desc_CN: 1.优化开机响应速度，缩短按键开机等待时间
2.优化手机后台切换至抖音时的音频播放体验
3.优化低音量场景下的底噪与声音断续问题
4.优化音乐暂停后的底噪表现
5.修复部分设备偶发杂音问题
desc_EN: 1.Optimize boot response speed and reduce the waiting time for power-on via key press.
2.Optimize the audio playback experience when switching to Douyin from the phone background.
3.Optimize background noise and audio stuttering issues under low volume conditions.
4.Optimize background noise performance after music playback is paused.
5.Fix occasional noise issues on some devices.

desc_CN: 1. 修复关机充电后重新开机，APP 电量显示异常的问题
2. 修复经典蓝牙回连成功后，APP 偶发连接失败的问题
3. 优化蓝牙模式下的音量表现，改善音量过高问题
4. 修复恢复出厂设置后，APP 断开连接时缺少提示音的问题
5. 修复充电状态下连接 APP 时，充电指示灯异常闪烁的问题
6. 修复频繁切换 EQ 时，耳机偶发死机的问题，提升设备稳定性
desc_EN: 1. Fixed an issue where the APP displayed incorrect battery level after powering on the device following charging while powered off
2. Fixed an occasional APP connection failure issue after classic Bluetooth reconnection succeeded
3. Optimized volume performance in Bluetooth mode to resolve excessive volume issues
4. Fixed the missing notification tone when the APP disconnects after factory reset
5. Fixed abnormal flashing of the charging indicator when connecting to the APP during charging
6. Fixed occasional headset crashes when switching EQ frequently to improve device stability
